source_title: I Earned $61,411 on Gumroad in 2025 and Still Feel Average

snippets.snippet_text: "Yesterday I got an email from Gumroad. Subject line: 'Your 2025 in review.' I opened it not expecting much. Instead, I saw two numbers that stopped me in my tracks: You earned a total of $61,411. (digital product sales only) You ranked #238 among all creators."

intake_notes: source_title null in stage 1 skeleton; inferred from URL slug by stage 2 converter.
Gumroad's own 2025-in-review email is the primary source cited; #238 ranking implies at least 238 active revenue-generating creators. Author is Gasper Crepinsek (referenced in DG finding notes).
$61,411 labelled 'digital product sales only' — gross Gumroad-reported figure, pre-fee. Downstream should note net amount is lower.
